body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Polaroid presented its instant digital camera and printer combo 'PoGo' at 2009 CES, which is available in the U.S and Europe market.

With the push of a button, consumers can select from among the digital photos on the camera, crop or edit them and in less than 60 seconds, print full-color, 2x3-inch prints – all with a single device.
The instant digital camera measures 4.7-inche wide by 3-inche tall and weighs only 10 ounces.
